_instructions: Phase A benchmark: the spoken cancellation (detect_cancel_intent, as cancel_check asks it on every user turn; strict mode while slot filling asks a closed-choice slot).
The benchmark asks the LLM for every case (the local check of the text is reported apart as the production decision).
id, language (en | es), description (English), category (kind of case), trap (built to provoke the critical error)
situation          : the task and what the robot had just asked (English, for the annotator; not sent to the LLM)
strict             : optional, true when the robot had asked a closed-choice question (the LLM is asked in strict mode); default false
expected_cancel    : true only if the user asks to abandon the current interaction entirely
Critical error (gate): a turn that is not a request to stop taken as one.
Traps: stop / cancel / quit / exit (parar, parada, cancelar, anular, dejar, salida, terminar) inside answers that go on with the task,
cancelling something that is the content of the task, farewells alone, corrections, negative answers and complaints that go on.
The labels are decided by a person; drop any case a careful annotator could label otherwise.
No case may reuse content of an evaluation scenario or of the examples of config/prompts.yaml (core/dataset_check.py checks it).
